title: Rama travels on toward Mithila
introduction: Sage Vishvamitra starts to narrate Kusha's legend. Vishvamitra is the offspring of Kusha's dynasty. Brahma gives boon to Kusha to beget four sons and one among them is Kushanaabha. Kushanabha begets a hundred daughters of excellent beauty. When Vayu, Air-god cherishes them all, those girls refuse him, as they prefer an arranged marriage by their father. Then Air-god in his indignation disfigures them all.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्वात्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 32nd chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मयोनिर्महानासीत् कुशो नाम महातपाः |
अक्लिष्टव्रतधर्मज्ञः सज्जनप्रतिपूजकः
verses.iast:
brahma yonir mahān āsīt kuśo nāma mahātapāḥ |
akliṣṭa vrata dharmaGYaḥ sajjana prati pūjakaḥ
verses.translation: "Once there was a highly righteous kingly sage who is the brainchild of Brahma, whose ascesis is of higher order, who has never flouted the rules of rituals or his vows, and who revered the knowers of virtue by name Kusha." Thus Sage Vishvamitra commenced narration.

glosses.meaning: one who has - without, hampered, vows, their virtue, knower - who has never flouted the rules of rituals and vows
in turn, revered - one who reveres virtue knowers

verses.devanagari:
स महात्मा कुलीनायां युक्तायां सुमहाबलान् |
वैदर्भ्यां जनयामास चतुरः सदृशान् सुतान्
कुशाम्बं कुशनाभं च अधूर्तरजसं वसुम् |
verses.iast:
sa mahātmā kulīnāyām yuk{}tāyām sumahābalān |
vaidarbhyām janayām āsa caturaḥ sadṛśān sutān
kuśāmbam kuśanābham ca āsūrtarajasam vasum |
verses.translation: "That great-souled Kusha begot four selfsame and mighty sons, namely Kusumba, Kushanaabha, Asuurtarajasa, or also called Adhuurtarajasa, and Vasu through the princess of Vidarbha, which princess is of noble birth and an eligible wife of Kusha.

verses.devanagari:
दीप्तियुक्तान् महोत्साहान् क्षत्रधर्मचिकीर्षया
तानुवाच कुशः पुत्रान् धर्मिष्ठान् सत्यवादिनः |
क्रियतां पालनं पुत्रा धर्मं प्राप्स्यथ पुष्कलम्
verses.iast:
dīpti yuk{}tān mahotsāhān kṣatradharma cikīrṣayā
tān uvāca kuśaḥ putrān dharmiṣṭhān satyavādinaḥ |
kriyatām pālanam putrā dharma prāpyatha puṣkalam
verses.translation: "With an aspiration that his sons shall uphold the principles of Kshatriya-s, Kusha spoke to them who are brilliant, highly enthusiastic, virtue abiding, and the advocators of truth saying, 'establish your rulership, sons, and achieve righteousness abundantly.'

glosses.meaning: Kshatriya, principle, with an aspiration to uphold
ruling over [kingdom,] let it be done - establish your rulership

verses.devanagari:
कुशस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा चत्वारो लोकसत्तमाः |
निवेशं चक्रिरे सर्वे पुराणां नृवरास्तदा
verses.iast:
kuśasya vacanam śrutvā catvāro loka sattamāḥ |
niveśam cakrire sarve purāṇām nṛ varāḥ tadā
verses.translation: "On hearing the words of Kusha those four sons that are the formidable ones in the world and the best men among people initiated to build four cities.

glosses.meaning: of cities, initiation - building, the started to do.

verses.devanagari:
कुशाम्बस्तु महातेजाः कौशांबीमकरोत् पुरीम् |
कुशनाभस्तु धर्मात्मा पुरं चक्रे महोदयम्
verses.iast:
kuśāmbaḥ tu mahātejāḥ kauśāmbīm akarot purīm |
kuśanābhaḥ tu dharmātmā puram cakre mahodayam
verses.translation: "Great-resplendent Kushamba built the city named Kaushambii for his part, and for his part the virtue-souled Kushanaabha built a city named Mahodaya.

glosses.meaning: great-resplendent one, Kushamba, for his part

verses.devanagari:
अधूर्तरजसो राम धर्मारण्यं महामतिः |
चक्रे पुरवरं राजा वसुर्नाम गिरिव्रजम्
verses.iast:
asūrtarajaso rāma dharmāraṇyam mahāmatiḥ |
cakre puravaram rājā vasur nāma girivrajam
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama, noble-minded Asuurtarajasa built a city named Dharmaaranya, and king Vasu built a city in the name of Girivraja.
notes: It is believed that the city Kaushambii is the present day Kannauj and Girivraja the present day Rajgir.

glosses.meaning: Girivraja, in the name of- city he built.

verses.devanagari:
एषा वसुमती नाम वसोस्तस्य महात्मनः |
एते शैलवराः पंच प्रकाशन्ते समंततः
verses.iast:
eṣā vasumatī nāma vasoḥ tasya mahātmanaḥ |
ete śailavarāḥ pañca prakāśante samantataḥ
verses.translation: "This land on which we are presently staying is known as the land of virtue-souled Vasu, all around which these five best mountains are standing high.

verses.devanagari:
सुमागधी नदी रम्या मागधान् विश्रुताययौ |
पंचानां शैलमुख्यानां मध्ये मालेव शोभते
verses.iast:
sumāgadhī nadī raṃyā māgadhān viśrutā āyayau |
pañcānām śaila mukhyānām madhye mālā iva śobhate
verses.translation: "This charming river that enters and exits Magadha province is well known as the worthy River Maagadhi, and flowing amid the five of these elevated mountains it shines forth like a garland enwreathing them.
notes: This river is said to be the present day River Son

glosses.meaning: maagadhii - worthy River Sona which took birth in Magadha country
coming, going - on entering and exiting
five of, mountains, important - elevated ones, amid

verses.devanagari:
सैषा हि मागधी राम वसोस्तस्य महात्मनः |
पूर्वाभिचरिता राम सुक्षेत्रा सस्यमालिनी
verses.iast:
sā eṣā hi māgadhī rāma vasoḥ tasya mahātmanaḥ |
pūrva abhicaritā rāma sukṣetrā sasya mālinī
verses.translation: "This Maagadhi is that river which pertains to the developmental works of the great-souled king Vasu and oh, Rama, flowing towards east to its confluence in Ganga, this river garlands best farmlands and their crops on its way.
notes: The confluence of this river with Ganga is said as the one now available near at Patna, Bihar.

glosses.meaning: of the great-souled one, his, of Vasu [this is that river which pertains to the developmental works of king Vasu]
to east, towards, while going - flowing

verses.devanagari:
कुशनाभस्तु राजर्षिः कन्याशतमनुत्तमम् |
जनयामास धर्मात्मा घृताच्यां रघुनंदन
verses.iast:
kuśanābhaḥ tu rājarṣiḥ kanyā śatam anuttamam |
janayāmāsa dharmātmā ghṛtācyām raghu nandana
verses.translation: "The virtue-souled kingly saint Kushanaabha gave birth to a hundred daughters with unexcelled beauty through a celestial female called Ghritaachi.
notes: Children begotten through celestial maidens are of superior nature for further procreating a divine generation, like Shakuntala, who begot Bharata, the earliest dynastic king.

verses.devanagari:
तास्तु यौवनशालिन्यो रूपवत्यः स्वलंकृताः |
उद्यानभूमिमागम्य प्रावृषीव शतह्रदाः
गायन्त्यो नृत्यमानाश्च वादयन्त्यश्च राघव |
आमोदं परमं जग्मुर्वराभरणभूषिताः
verses.iast:
tāḥ tu yauvana śālinyo rūpavatyaḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ |
udyāna bhūmim āgaṃya prāvṛṣi iva śatahradāḥ
gāyantyo nṛtyamānāḥ ca vādayantyaḥ ca rāghava |
āmodam paramam jagmur vara ābharaṇa bhūṣitāḥ
verses.translation: "Those girls when attained youthfulness they are lovely and on an occasion they have gone to gardens and moved there about like one lightning with a hundred streaks during rainy season, and while those girls that are decorated with select ornaments are singing, dancing and playing musical instruments, they got into a fantastic felicity.

glosses.meaning: in hundred way, flowing - like hundred streaked lightning

verses.devanagari:
अथ ताश्चारुसर्वांग्यो रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि |
उद्यानभूमिमागम्य तारा इव घनान्तरे
verses.iast:
atha tāḥ cāru sarva aṅgyo rūpeṇa apratimā bhuvi |
udyāna bhūmim āgaṃya tārā iva ghana antare
verses.translation: "On their coming to parklands those girls whose all limbs are pretty and whose looks are unparalleled on earth, they looked like stars amid clouds within the cloudy thickets of garden bushes.

glosses.meaning: pretty, all, with limbs - whose all limbs are pretty
by aspect, on earth, un, paralleled

verses.devanagari:
ताः सर्वगुणसंपन्ना रूपयौवनसंयुताः |
दृष्ट्वा सर्वात्मको वायुरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tāḥ sarvaguṇa sampannā rūpa yauvana saṃyutāḥ |
dṛṣṭvā sarvātmako vāyur idam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: "On seeing them who are flourishing with all their aspects together with comeliness and ripeness, the all pervading Air-god, Vayu, spoke this word to them.

verses.devanagari:
अहं वः कामये सर्वा भार्या मम भविष्यथ |
मानुषस्त्यज्यतां भावो दीर्घमायुरवाप्स्यथ
verses.iast:
aham vaḥ kāmaye sarvā bhāryā mama bhaviṣyatha |
mānuṣaḥ tyajyatām bhāvo dīrgham āyur avāpsyatha
verses.translation: " 'I have a desire for you all, hence leaving off the notions pertaining to human beings you all become my wives, thereby you too will acquire longevity like divinities.

glosses.meaning: I, all, you, have a desire for
pertaining to humans, leave off, notion
long, life, you acquire - like divinities.

verses.devanagari:
चलं हि यौवनं नित्यं मानुषेषु विशेषतः |
अक्षय्यं यौवनं प्राप्ता अमर्यश्च भविष्य्थ
verses.iast:
calam hi yauvanam nityam mānuṣeṣu viśeṣataḥ |
akśayam yauvanam prāptā amaryaḥ ca bhaviṣytha
verses.translation: " 'Teenage is always transitory, expressly in humans, but on marrying me you will achieve undiminished youthfulness and forever you can be youthful like immortal females.' Thus Air-god said to those girls.

glosses.meaning: as immortal females, also, you can become.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वायोरक्लिष्टकर्मणः |
अपहास्य ततो वाक्यं कन्याशतमथाब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tasya tad vacanam śrutvā vāyoḥ akliṣṭa karmaṇaḥ |
apahāsya tato vākyam kanyā śatam atha abravīt
verses.translation: "On hearing that proposal of Vayu, the Air-god whose strives are unimpeded, then those hundred girls spoke this sentence laughing off his proposal.

verses.devanagari:
अन्तश्चरसि भूतानां सर्वेषां त्वं सुरसत्तम |
प्रभावज्ञाश्च ते सर्वाः किमर्थमवमन्यसे
verses.iast:
antaḥ carasi bhūtānām sarveṣām tvam sura sattama |
prabhāvaGYāḥ ca te sarvāḥ kim artham avamanyase
verses.translation: " 'we are aware that you inspirit all the living beings from inside, oh, the ablest divinity, we are also aware of your uniqueness. But, what for you are dishonouring all of us.

glosses.meaning: you, in all, of the beings
all of us, your, uniqueness, knowers, also
for what, reason, not, you honour [you dishonour us.]

verses.devanagari:
कुशनाभसुताः देवं समस्ता सुरसत्तम |
स्थानाच्च्यावयितुं देवं रक्षामस्तु तपो वयम्
verses.iast:
kuśanābha sutāḥ devam samastā sura sattama |
sthānāt cyāvayitum devam rakṣāmaḥ tu tapo vayam
verses.translation: " 'We are the daughters of Kushanaabha, oh, best divinity, and we are all capable of displacing you from your realm, but oh, god, we are restraining ourselves in doing so only to conserve our ascetic values.

verses.devanagari:
मा भूत्सकालो दुर्मेधः पितरं सत्यवादिनम् |
अवमन्य स्वधर्मेण स्वयंवरमुपास्महे
verses.iast:
mā bhūt sa kālo durmedhaḥ pitaram satya vādinam |
avamanyasva sva dharmeṇa svayam varam upāsmahe
verses.translation: " 'That time shall never come, oh, god with sordid thinking, when we, at our liberty, may look up for our grooms overlooking our veracious father.'

glosses.meaning: oh, evil, minded one - god with sordid thinking
independently, groom, [at which time we] look up

verses.devanagari:
पिता हि प्रभुरस्माकं दैवतं परमं च सः |
यस्य नो दास्यति पिता स नो भर्ता भविष्यति
verses.iast:
pitā hi prabhur asmākam daivatam paramam ca saḥ |
yasya no dāsyati pitā sa no bhartā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: " 'Our father is indeed our lord and for us he is the ultimate god too. To whomever we are offered by our father in marriage he alone becomes our husband.' So said hundred girls to Air-god.

verses.devanagari:
तासां तु वचनं श्रुत्वा हरिः परमकोपनः |
प्रविश्य सर्वगात्राणि बभंज भगवान् प्रभुः
verses.iast:
tāsām tu vacanam śrutvā hariḥ parama kopanaḥ |
praviśya sarva gātrāṇi babhañja bhagavān prabhuḥ
verses.translation: On hearing their sentence of rejection, Vayu, the Air-god whose impact is powerful, very angrily entered into all of the limbs of those girls only to disfigure them.

verses.devanagari:
ताः कन्या वायुना भग्ना विविशुर्नृपतेर्गृहम् |
प्रविश्य च सुसंभ्रान्ताः सलज्जाः साश्रुलोचनाः
verses.iast:
tāḥ kanyā vāyunā bhagnā viviśur nṛpateḥ gṛham |
praviśya ca susambhrāntāḥ sa lajjāḥ sa asra locana
verses.translation: "Those girls whom Air-god disfigured in that way have entered palace-chambers of the king, but they have entered diffidently, embarrassedly, and tearfully.

verses.devanagari:
स च ता दयिता भग्नाः कन्याः परमशोभनाः |
दृष्ट्वा दीनास्तदा राजा संभ्रांत इदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa ca tā dayitā bhagnāḥ kanyāḥ parama śobhanāḥ |
dṛṣṭvā dīnāḥ tadā rājā sambhrānta idam abravīt
verses.translation: "That king on seeing his dear and attractive daughters as disfigured and despondent girls he is highly perturbed and said this.

verses.devanagari:
किमिदं कथ्यतां पुत्र्यः को धर्ममवमन्यते |
कुब्जाः केन कृताः सर्वा चेष्टन्त्यो नाभिभाषथ |
एवं राजा विनिःश्वस्य समाधिं संदधे ततः
verses.iast:
kim idam kathyatām putryaḥ ko dharmam avamanyate |
kub.hjāḥ kena kṛtāḥ sarvāḥ ceṣṭantyo na abhibhāṣatha |
evam rājā viniḥśvasya samādhim sandadhe tataḥ
verses.translation: " 'Oh, daughters, what all is this? Who disregarded probity? Who disfigured you all? Let it be said! Why you gesticulate saying nothing.' asking thus that king sighed and quietened down waiting for a reply." Thus Sage Vishvamitra continued his narration.

glosses.meaning: all of you, dwarfed [with hunchbacks, disfigured]
rumination, imposed upon himself - remained silent for their reply.
